description: This file implements the LMNT text-to-speech (TTS) service, utilizing WebSocket API for real-time streaming audio synthesis. It handles connection management, language code conversion, and frame processing for TTS operations.

classes.name: LmntTTSService
classes.description: A service class providing real-time text-to-speech synthesis using LMNT's WebSocket API, supporting connection management, streaming, and configuration of language, voice, and model parameters.
